SpriteObjClippingY.name: Sprite-block interaction and Y clip table
summary: Y offsets of each sprite's four clipping points (right, left, down, up), 4 entries per clipping set (low nibble of [$1656]).
$019138: long-callable wrapper. Clears the sprite's blocked status, slope and liquid flags, then checks layer 1 and (if
[$5B] bit 7) layer 2: liquid and water/lava splash, the layer 2 carry, pushing the sprite out of walls, then calls the
vertical ($0192C9) and horizontal ($019288) block checks. Layer in use is kept in [$185E] (0 = layer 1, 1 = layer 2).
Quirk: Return019283 is also the Y = 0 entry of the wall push-out tables below.

s019284.name: Data: sprite wall push-out offsets
summary: X offsets (low and high bytes) used to push a sprite out of a wall: -4 for right, +4 for left.

s019288.name: Sprite horizontal block check
summary: Looks up the tile at the sprite's side clipping point (right if moving right, left if moving left) and, if solid ($11-$6D
acts-like), marks the side as blocked. Sets [$1862], [$18A7], [$1860] and status bit 6 for layer 2.
$01928E: alternate entry, side taken from bit 0 of A.

s0192C1.name: Data: sprite X nudge on rope tiles
summary: $0192C1 is unreferenced. $0192C5/$0192C7: X offsets (+1/-1) for acts-like tiles $0C/$0D.

s0192C9.name: Sprite vertical check and map16 lookup
summary: $0192C9: checks the bottom point (moving down) or top point (moving up) against the map. Ceilings mark the block; floors
handle lava, slopes and landing, setting [$1694] (surface offset) and [$15B8] (slope steepness).
$019425: copies the clip point to the block position [$98]-[$9B]; $019435: sets the blocked bit from [$0F].
$019441: reads the tile at clipping point Y (0-3) and returns it in [$1693] (acts-like), Z set for page 0 tiles.
Handles horizontal and vertical levels and both layers, out-of-level points return tile 0.

HandleSprStunned.name: Stunned sprite main (start)
summary: Sprite status 9 handler. Yoshi egg check, continued below.

YoshiShellSts9.name: Stunned sprite: egg and special cases
summary: Yoshi egg: with non-zero state only draws; springboard, unused sprite $85 and P-balloon return to normal status.

SetNormalStatus.name: Stunned sprite physics; set normal status
summary: $019562: sets sprite status 8 (normal) and goes to the shared graphics routine.
$01956A: if sprites are not locked, runs the stun logic, moves the sprite, handles landing (halve X speed, bounce), egg hatching,
ceiling hits (hit the block above), and walls (X speed / 4), then interaction, graphics and off-screen check.
$0196CB (second routine with the same name): status = 8 and clear vertical flip.

Unused0195FC.name: Unused. Table of sprite numbers
summary: Unused. $04-$07 map to themselves, repeated four times.

SpriteKoopasSpawn.name: Koopa spawn table; Bob-omb and shell timers
summary: $01961C: shelless Koopa sprite number for each shelled Koopa sprite number ($04-$07 -> $00-$03).
$019624: Bob-omb explosion (fuse = 1: sound, [$1540] = $40) and flashing; other sprites: when [$1558] = 1 reload tables, face
Mario and become normal or kicked; then the stun timer ([$1540]) logic.

UnstunSprite.name: Wake up stunned sprite
summary: Called when [$1540] is 3 or 1. Buzzy Beetle, Spike Top, Mecha-Koopa and Goomba return to normal; Baby Yoshi and Yoshi egg
stay; Throw Block vanishes; any other sprite spawns a shelless Koopa (GeneralResetSpr).

IncrmntStunTimer.name: Slow the stun timer
summary: Adds 1 to [$1540] every other frame, so the stun counts down at half speed.
